prompt_md: Your friend sets off walking at 4 km/h. An hour later you follow on a bike at 12 km/h along the same road. How many minutes until you catch up?
prompt_short: Friend walks at 4 km/h with an hour's head start. You cycle at 12. Minutes?
hint_md: Your friend keeps walking while you chase.
explain_intuition_md: Covering the 4 km head start at 12 km/h takes 20 minutes, but your friend doesn't wait. You only gain 8 km/h on them, so closing 4 km takes half an hour.
explain_math_md: Gap $4$ km, closing speed $12 - 4 = 8$ km/h: $\frac{4}{8} = 0.5$ h $= 30$ min.
